text: HCMC's lending to social housing, industrial parks and tourism tops $4.25b

Outstanding real estate loans for social housing, industrial parks and export processing zones (EPZs), and tourism in Ho Chi Minh City exceeded VND112 trillion ($4.25 billion) as of the end of October 2026.
The figure accounts for approximately 7% of the city's total outstanding real estate credit, according to data from the State Bank of Vietnam's Region 2 Branch.
Social housing loans reached VND5.873 trillion, up 36% from the end of 2025 and 39% year-on-year.

The growth was supported by commercial banks' continued implementation of the Government's social housing development policy, alongside credit and lending rate measures introduced by the State Bank of Vietnam.
Meanwhile, real estate credit for infrastructure development in industrial parks and EPZs reached VND78.868 trillion, up 2.24% from the end of 2025 and 11.1% year-on-year.
By contrast, outstanding loans to restaurants, hotels, tourist areas, eco-tourism sites and resorts stood at VND27.847 trillion, down 15.7% from the end of 2025 and 9.6% year-on-year.
